components.css: .ds-glass{padding:32px;border-radius:28px;color:#FCF4EC;background:linear-gradient(140deg,rgb(255 255 255/.13),rgb(255 255 255/.04) 60%);border:1px solid rgb(255 255 255/.15);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255/.2),0 30px 60px -32px rgb(0 0 0/.6);backdrop-filter:blur(22px) saturate(160%)}.ds-glass h3{font:400 32px/1.08 Prata,Georgia,serif;margin:0}.ds-glass p{font:400 17px/1.6 'Albert Sans',sans-serif;color:rgb(252 244 236/.8)}

narrative.overview: The site is the logo turned into architecture: cream and night fields like rooms, one bronze door as the only accent, glass as the window material, and one authored motion per page.
keyCharacteristics: Glass over content, never over nothing

rules.name: The One Metal Rule
rules.body: Bronze is the only accent; green and red stay state colors.

rules.name: The Readable Bronze Rule
rules.body: Bronze text on cream uses Deep Bronze #7D6035.

rules.name: The Window Rule
rules.body: Glass only where something shows through it.

rules.name: The Soft Night Rule
rules.body: No pure white, no near-black: text #EAE0D3, darkest field #1A1613.

dos: Do use Door Bronze for the quote action with an ink label
Do keep secondary text at ink 70% or cream 60% minimum
Do drive scroll effects with CSS animation-timeline or WAAPI on a ViewTimeline; nothing runs at rest
donts: Don't put an eyebrow above a heading
Don't use glass over an empty cream area
Don't caption the ambience photo as a Chaudrel job
Don't add smooth-scroll libraries or infinite animations
